z-m-11-01.title: Isamba sikhulu kunenani labafundi. Ingabe ithebula liphutha?
z-m-11-01.topic: Izamba zethebula nenani labantu abacwaningiwe (idatha lapho umuntu oyedwa aphawule kaningi)
z-m-11-01.goal: Uma isamba ethebuleni sihluke enanini labafundi abacwaningiwe, ungaphetha ngokuthi ithebula liphutha, kodwa sho ukuthi yini enye odinga ukuyazi njengendlela yocwaningo, bese ulungisa isinqumo sakho ngolwazi olusha.
z-m-11-01.material:
Iklasi 3 leBanga 4 nabafundi abangu-28. Bacwaninge 'indawo abafuna ukuya kuyo lohambo lwesifundo' futhi benza ithebula elingezansi. Izinombolo ethebuleni ziyinani labafundi abafake u-○ kuleyo ndawo.

| Indawo | Inyuvesi yezinto zakudala | Isu | Isikhungo sesayensi | Iphakhi lokuzijabulisa | Isamba |
| Abafundi (inani labantu) | 12 | 10 | 9 | 7 | 38 |

U-Jia uthe, "Isamba singu-38 kodwa iklasi yethu inabafundi abangu-28. Ithebula liphutha!" (Ithebula libhalwe ngamagama, ngakho akukho sithombe. Imigqa yethebula, kusukela phezulu, ngendawo nenani labafundi.)
z-m-11-01.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa lokho ithebula lodwa elingakusho nalokho elingakusho
z-m-11-01.thinking.1: Ukusho wena ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo
z-m-11-01.thinking.2: Ukulungisa isinqumo sakho nokuzethemba isikhathi ngasinye kuvela ulwazi olusha
z-m-11-01.prereq.0: Ukufunda inombolo yento ngayinye ethebuleni nokwengeza (izinga lamabanga 3-4)
z-m-11-01.prereq.1: Ukuthi ocwaningweni kukhona amacala 'umuntu oyedwa ekhetha into eyodwa kuphela' namacala 'umuntu oyedwa ekhetha izinto eziningana'
z-m-11-01.s.s1.prompt: Idatha eyengeziwe iyembulwa ngesikhathi esisodwa. Khetha ukucabanga kwakho isikhathi ngasinye.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala isamba nenani labafundi eceleni komunye bese uqala ubheke ukuthi bahluka kangakanani.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.hint.1: Usebenzisa isibonelo esincane (abafundi abangu-3), bala ukuthi kunezimpawu ezingaki ngaphezulu kunabafundi uma umuntu oyedwa ephawula izindawo ezimbili.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Okwaziwayo manje kuyithebula kuphela nenani labafundi (28). Ishidi locwaningo alikabonwa.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Isamba esingu-38 singase sibe ngenxa yendlela yocwaningo, noma ngoba umfundi ofanayo wabalwa kabili ngenkathi ebalwa. Ungazi kuphela ngokubheka ishidi locwaningo.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Isamba sihluke enanini labafundi, ngakho ithebula labalwa ngokungalungile
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Usole indlela yokubala ngoba nje isamba sihluke enanini labafundi. Qala ucabange ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kuye ngendlela yocwaningo.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kuze kube sibona ishidi locwaningo, asikwazi ukwazi ukuthi ithebula liphutha yini
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Umile endaweni efanele. Lo ngumcabango okhumbule ukuthi ngethebula elifanayo, isamba singahluka kuye ngendlela yocwaningo.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Uma isamba sikhulu kunenani labafundi, ithebula lihlala lilungile
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ngokuphambene, wakholwa ngokushesha kakhulu. Isizathu sokuthi isamba sikhulu kungaba iphutha lokubala, ngakho udinga ukuhlola.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Ishidi locwaningo lithe, "Phawula u-○ ezindaweni ofuna ukuya kuzo. Ungakhetha ezimbili ngokuphezulu." Thishela owaqala ukuhlela amashidi uthe bonke abafundi abangu-28 baphawule u-○ endaweni eyodwa okungenani.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Bangaki abafundi abafake u-○ ezindaweni ezimbili?
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Njengoba uthisha ethe, wonke umuntu uphawule indawo eyodwa okungenani futhi ezimbili ngokuphezulu, izimpawu ezingu-38 zilingana nabafundi abangu-28 kuhlanganiswe nenani labafundi abakhethe izindawo ezimbili. Ngakho abafundi abangu-10 bakhethe izindawo ezimbili.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wenze kahle ukuthola ukuthi inani olitholayo ngokukhipha inani labafundi, 28, ezimpawini ze-○, 38, yinani lezimpawu ezenziwe 'kanye futhi'.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kubukeka sengathi ucabange uhhafu ka-28. Cabanga ukuthi umehluko phakathi kwezimpawu ezingu-38 nabafundi abangu-28 usho ini.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kubukeka sengathi ucabange uhhafu ka-38. Bala ukuthi kunezimpawu ezingaki ngaphezulu kunabafundi uma umuntu oyedwa ekhetha izindawo ezimbili.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Lapho uthisha ehlola amashidi ocwaningo futhi kusukela ekuqaleni, isitatimende sangaphambilini sasiphutha. Abafundi abangu-4 abazange baphawule u-○ endaweni ethile, futhi abanye abangu-24 baphawule u-○ endaweni eyodwa noma ezimbili.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Manje, bangaki abafundi abafake u-○ ezindaweni ezimbili?
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Phakathi kwabafundi abangu-24, uma abangu-10 bakhethe indawo eyodwa kuphela futhi abangu-14 bakhethe ezimbili, inani lezimpawu ngu-10+28=38. Uma kufika ulwazi olusha, impendulo iyashintsha noma ngethebula elifanayo.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uxubanise inani labafundi abangaphawulanga ndawo nenani labafundi abaphawule izindawo ezimbili. Labo bangabantu abahlukile.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ugcine impendulo yesinyathelo sangaphambilini njengoba injalo. Hlola futhi ukuthi abafundi abangu-4 osanda kubafunda badinga yini ukungena ekubaleni.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lo ngumcabango osebenze futhi ngolwazi olusha. Uthole icala lapho abafundi abangu-24 bekhetha indawo eyodwa noma ezimbili futhi inani lezimpawu liba ngu-38.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni, ukucabanga kwakho bekusondele ku-'ithebula liphutha' noma ku-'asikwazi ukusho'? Ishidi locwaningo nolwazi ngabafundi abangu-4 abangaphenduli ngayinye lushintshe ini? Uma kusekhona okungazi, kuyini?
z-m-11-01.s.s2.prompt: Uyazi ukuthi ishidi locwaningo lithe 'izindawo ezimbili ngokuphezulu'. Khetha konke ongakusho ngokuphephile usebenzisa izinombolo zethebula kuphela nalokho okusesidlini socwaningo.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngomfundi oyedwa ofake u-○ ezindaweni ezimbili, inyuvesi yezinto zakudala nesibaya. Uya emabhokisini ayiphi?
z-m-11-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kusitatimende ngasinye, bheka ukuthi 'umfundi ofanayo ungabalwa kabili' yini.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.o.a: Abafundi abakhethe inyuvesi yezinto zakudala noma isibaya bangu-22 sekukonke
z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.a: 12+10=22 kungase kube yinani elibale umfundi okhethe zombili izindawo kabili. Ungasho ukuthi bangabafundi abangu-22 'noma ngaphansi', kodwa awukwazi ukusho ngokuqinisekile ukuthi bangu-22.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.o.b: Abafundi abakhethe inyuvesi yezinto zakudala bangu-12
z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.b: Ibhokisi elilodwa lethebula liyinani labafundi abafake u-○ kuleyo ndawo, ngakho ungakufunda ngale ndlela.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.o.c: 38, isamba sezinombolo ezine ethebuleni, yinani labafundi abafake u-○
z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.c: 38 yinani lezikhathi u-○ aphawulwe ngazo. Umfundi oyedwa angase aphawule kabili, ngakho akumele ukufunde njengenani labafundi.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.o.d: Abafundi abangu-12 abakhethe inyuvesi yezinto zakudala nabafundi abangu-10 abakhethe isibaya bangabafundi abahlukile
z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.d: Ubungakhetha izindawo ezimbili, ngakho umfundi ofanayo ubengaba kumaqembu womabili.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.o.e: Abafundi abakhethe isikhungo sesayensi bangu-2 ngaphezulu kwabafundi abakhethe iphakhi lokuzijabulisa
z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.e: Ibhokisi ngalinye liyinani labafundi abakhethe leyo ndawo, ngakho isitatimende esiqhathanisa amabhokisi amabili siphephile.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.explain: Inombolo ebhokisini elilodwa iyinani labafundi abakhethe leyo ndawo, ngakho isitatimende esifunda ibhokisi elilodwa noma siqhathanisa amabhokisi amabili siphephile. Inani elengeza amabhokisi lingabale umfundi ofanayo kaningi, ngakho awukwazi ukulifunda njengo-'nani labafundi'.
z-m-11-01.s.s3.prompt: U-Jia uthe, "Isamba sikhulu kunenani labafundi, ngakho ithebula liphutha!" Ungatshela ini u-Jia? Bhala futhi ukuthi yini enye odinga ukuyazi ukunquma ukuthi ithebula liphutha yini.
z-m-11-01.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi ucwaningo kumele luqhutshwe kanjani ukuze isamba sethebula silingane nenani labafundi.
z-m-11-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala okungenani isizathu esisodwa esingenzeka sokuthi isamba sikhulu, bese uhambisanisa ngasinye nalokho ongadinga ukukubheka ukuze usihlole.
z-m-11-01.s.s3.placeholder: isb., Noma isamba sikhulu, ngidinga ukwazi ...
z-m-11-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ugwemile ukusho ukuthi ithebula liphutha, futhi washo okungenani icala elilodwa lapho isamba singaba sikhulu?
z-m-11-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale ngokukhonkolo 'yini enye odinga ukuyazi'?
z-m-11-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe lokho owakubhale kuzwakala njengokuhlola ndawonye, ngaphandle kokwenza u-Jia azwe ephutha?
z-m-11-01.s.s3.model.0: Isamba esikhulu asisho ukuthi liphutha ngokushesha. Uma ucwaningo lwavumela umuntu ngamunye ukufaka u-○ ezindaweni ezimbili noma ngaphezulu, isamba singaba sikhulu kunenani labafundi. Ake siqale sihlole eshidini locwaningo ukuthi bekungakhethwa izindawo ezingaki.
z-m-11-01.s.s3.model.1: Asikazi okwamanje ukuthi ithebula liphutha yini. Abafundi abavela kwenye iklasi bangase baphendule nabo, noma umfundi ofanayo angase abalwe kabili, ngakho kumele sihlole ukuthi ngubani ophendule nokuthi babalwa kanjani.
z-m-11-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kwathiwa futhi hlola, ngaphandle kwezimpendulo eziningi, ibanga labantu abaphendulayo nendlela yokubala.
z-m-11-01.s.s3.model.2: Umbono ka-Jia awulungile. Ithebula lilungile. Uma ungakhetha izindawo eziningana, isamba singaba sikhulu kunenani labafundi, ngakho ake sihlole ishidi locwaningo.

z-m-11-02.title: Indlela ka-Minseo yokufunda i-pictograph: yini ebukeka ingajwayelekile?
z-m-11-02.topic: Okumelwa isithombe esikhulu nesithombe esincane ku-pictograph
z-m-11-02.goal: Bonisa ngesibonelo esiphikisayo ukuthi ku-pictograph lapho izithombe zosayizi abahlukile zinamanani ahlukile, ukuqhathanisa ngokubala izithombe kuphela kungaba iphutha, bese usho izimo lapho ukuqhathanisa ngokubala kulungile.
z-m-11-02.material:
Inani lezinkwa ezithengiswe ngosuku ezindaweni zokubhaka ezine zomakhelwane lisetshenziswa ku-pictograph. Isithombe esisodwa esikhulu sesinkwa simelela izinkwa ezingu-10, futhi isithombe esisodwa esincane sesinkwa simelela isinkwa esingu-1. Akukho sithombe, ngakho kubhalwe ngamagama.

| Indawo yokubhaka | Izithombe ezinkulu zesinkwa | Izithombe ezincane zesinkwa |
| 가 | 3 | 4 |
| 나 | 2 | 9 |
| 다 | 4 | 0 |
| 라 | 3 | 7 |

U-Minseo ufunde leli grafu futhi wafingqa ngemigqa eyisithupha engezansi.
z-m-11-02.prereq.0: Ukufunda izinombolo ezimelelwa yisithombe esikhulu nesincane bese uzibhala njengamashumi neyodwa (izinga le-pictograph yeBanga 3)
z-m-11-02.s.s1.prompt: Yimuphi umugqa wengqikithi ka-Minseo ongajwayelekile? (Izinombolo zemigqa ziqala ku-1.)
z-m-11-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ukuhlola okusho umugqa 6, thola inani lezinkwa ezithengiswe yindawo yokubhaka enezithombe eziningi kakhulu neyenezithombe ezimbalwa kakhulu, bese uzibeka eceleni komunye.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.hint.1: Beka futhi izinombolo ezithengiswe owazitholile emigqeni 2 kuya ku-4 ngokulandelana kosayizi, bese uziqhathanisa nesiphetho somugqa 6.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.0: 1. Isithombe esisodwa esikhulu sesinkwa simelela izinkwa ezingu-10, futhi isithombe esisodwa esincane sesinkwa simelela isinkwa esingu-1.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.1: 2. Indawo yokubhaka 가 inezithombe ezinkulu ezingu-3 nezithombe ezincane ezingu-4, ngakho ithengise izinkwa ezingu-30+4=34.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.2: 3. Indawo yokubhaka 나 inezithombe ezinkulu ezingu-2 nezithombe ezincane ezingu-9, ngakho ithengise izinkwa ezingu-20+9=29.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.3: 4. Indawo yokubhaka 다 inezithombe ezinkulu ezingu-4 kuphela, ngakho ithengise izinkwa ezingu-40. Indawo yokubhaka 라 inezithombe ezinkulu ezingu-3 nezithombe ezincane ezingu-7, ngakho ithengise izinkwa ezingu-37.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.4: 5. Inani lezithombe zezindawo zokubhaka ezine ngu-가 7, 나 11, 다 4, 라 10.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.5: 6. Indawo yokubhaka enezithombe eziningi kakhulu yindawo yokubhaka 나 (11), ngakho indawo yokubhaka 나 ithengise isinkwa esiningi kakhulu.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 6 awujwayelekile. Kuleli grafu, izithombe zosayizi abahlukile zimelela izinombolo ezihlukile, ngakho ukuba nezithombe eziningi akusho ukuthengisa okuningi. Indawo yokubhaka 나 inezithombe ezingu-11 kodwa ithengise u-29, futhi indawo yokubhaka 다 inezithombe ezingu-4 kuphela kodwa, ngoba ziyizithombe ezinkulu, ithengise u-40, okuningi kakhulu.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.prompt: Kuleli grafu, ukuqhathanisa ngokubala inani lezithombe kungaba iphutha. Khetha onke amacala lapho ungasho ukuthi uhlangothi luni olunokuningi ngokubheka inani lezithombe kuphela.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.hint.0: Thatha indawo yokubhaka 가 (ezinkulu 3, ezincane 4) nendawo yokubhaka 나 (ezinkulu 2, ezincane 9), bese uqhathanisa inani lezithombe ezinkulu nenani lezithombe ezincane ngokwehlukana.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, yenza isibonelo esisodwa bese uhlola ukuthi uhlangothi olunezithombe eziningi kumele lube lithengise okuningi nalo yini.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.o.a: Icala lapho zombili izindawo zokubhaka zisebenzisa izithombe ezinkulu zesinkwa kuphela
z-m-11-02.s.s2.r.a: Uma kunosayizi owodwa kuphela wesithombe, isithombe esisodwa simelela inani elifanayo, ngakho ukuqhathanisa kuphela inani lezithombe kulungile.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.o.b: Icala lapho umehluko wenani lezithombe mkhulu kakhulu, njengo-11 no-4
z-m-11-02.s.s2.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi umehluko omkhulu ungaphephile. Bheka 나 no-다 kuleli grafu: noma ngomehluko omkhulu, kuguquke.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.o.c: Icala lapho indawo yokubhaka eyodwa inezithombe ezinkulu ezengeziwe nezithombe ezincane ezengeziwe kunenye
z-m-11-02.s.s2.r.c: Uthole ukuthi uma inakho kokubili ezinkulu nezincane ezengeziwe, isamba kumele sibe sikhulu nasso.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.o.d: Icala lapho zombili izindawo zokubhaka zisebenzisa inhlanganisela yezithombe ezinkulu nezincane
z-m-11-02.s.s2.r.d: Ukuxutshwa kuphela akukuvumeli ukuqhathanisa. Kumele ubheke ngokwehlukana ukuthi kunezithombe ezinkulu ezingakanani nezithombe ezincane ezingakanani.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.explain: Uma kunosayizi owodwa kuphela wesithombe, noma uma uhlangothi olulodwa lunezithombe ezinkulu ezengeziwe nezithombe ezincane ezengeziwe, ungahlulela ngenani lezithombe kuphela. Uma osayizi bexutshiwe futhi uhlangothi olulodwa lunezithombe ezinkulu eziningi kodwa olunye lunezithombe ezincane eziningi, kumele uthole amanani bese uqhathanisa.
z-m-11-02.s.s3.prompt: Chazela u-Minseo, usebenzisa izinombolo, ukuthi kungani isitatimende somugqa 6 singahambelani nalelo grafu. (Bhala inani lezithombe nenani elithengiswe kwezindawo zokubhaka ezimbili.)
z-m-11-02.s.s3.hint.0: Thola inani lezithombe nenani elithengiswe kwindawo yokubhaka 다 nendawo yokubhaka 나, bese ubabhala emigqeni emibili.
z-m-11-02.s.s3.hint.1: Qala ubhale emusheni owodwa ukuthi inani lezithombe elikhulu noma elincane nenani elithengiswe elikhulu noma elincane kuhluka kanjani ezindaweni zokubhaka ezimbili.
z-m-11-02.s.s3.placeholder: isb., Indawo yokubhaka 나 inezithombe ezingu-... kodwa ...
z-m-11-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubale ukuhlola ukuthi inani lezithombe nenani elithengiswe ezindaweni ezimbili zokubhaka owazinikeza ziyahambisana?
z-m-11-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi kungani "izithombe eziningi ≠ ukuthengisa okuningi" kwenzeka (izithombe zimelela izinombolo ezihlukile)?
z-m-11-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Uma wengeze icala lapho ukuqhathanisa ngenani lezithombe kulungile, ingabe uhlolé ukuthi leli cala lisebenza ngempela?
z-m-11-02.s.s3.model.0: Indawo yokubhaka 나 inezithombe eziningi kakhulu ngo-11, kodwa inezithombe ezinkulu ezingu-2 kuphela, ngakho kungu-20+9=29. Indawo yokubhaka 다 inezithombe ezingu-4 kuphela, kodwa zonke ziyizithombe ezinkulu, ngakho kungu-40. Izithombe zimelela izinombolo ezihlukile kuye ngosayizi, ngakho akumele ubale nje izithombe.
z-m-11-02.s.s3.model.1: Isithombe esisodwa esikhulu singu-10 futhi isithombe esisodwa esincane singu-1, ngakho awungezi ngenani lezithombe; wengeza izithombe ezinkulu ngo-10 nezithombe ezincane ngo-1. Khona indawo yokubhaka 가 ingu-34 futhi indawo yokubhaka 라 ingu-37, futhi izithombe zingu-7 no-10, ngakho ukulandelana kuyafana kodwa umehluko uhlukile.
z-m-11-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Futhi inikeze isibonelo lapho ukulandelana kufana, ukuhlukanisa necala elilungile ngenhlanhla.

z-m-11-04.title: Kungani imiphumela ihluka phakathi kokuphakamisa isandla nokuvota ngamapapha?
z-m-11-04.topic: Indlela yocwaningo (ukuphakamisa isandla, ukuvota ngamapapha) ithinta kanjani umphumela
z-m-11-04.goal: Hlola ngedatha ukuthi ngeklasi efanayo, indlela yocwaningo ehlukile inganika umphumela ohlukile, futhi ubhale kabusha lokho ongakusho nokuthi ungaqiniseka kangakanani njalo uma kufika idatha entsha.
z-m-11-04.material: Iklasi 2 yeBanga 4 inabafundi abangu-24. Bafuna ukunquma umdlalo abangawudlala ndawonye ngesikhathi sokuphumula. Abangenela bangu-dodgeball, imidlalo yebhodi, nokweqa intambo, futhi umuntu ngamunye uvotela eyodwa kuphela. Ingxenye ka-24 ingu-12.
z-m-11-04.thinking.0: Ukuqhathanisa amasethi amabili edatha ezindleleni ezihlukene
z-m-11-04.thinking.1: Ukulungisa ibanga lalokho okushoyo uma kufika idatha entsha

z-m-11-03.title: I-bar graph yamakhathoni obisi: isikhala esisodwa sesikali kumele sibe ngakanani?

z-m-11-03.material:
Sifuna ukubonisa inani lamakhathoni obisi aqoqwe amaqembu amane eBanga 4 esikoleni sethu nge-bar graph.

- Inani elikhulu kakhulu (60) kumele lifanele ngaphakathi kwegrafu. Okungukuthi, isikali esiphezulu kumele sibe ngu-60 noma ngaphezulu.
- Isiphetho sebha ngalinye kumele sihlale ncamashi emgqeni wesikali ukuze inani lifundeke ncamashi.

z-m-11-07.material:
